ma.removeTabBarBadge(Object object)

Removes the text in the upper right corner of a tabbar item (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
index Number Indicates the item in the tabbar. The item starts from 0 and starts from the left.
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

Sample Code

ma.removeTabBarBadge({
  index: 0
})

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String removeTabBarBadge: ok

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String Error information
errno Integer Error code

Error Code List

Error Scenario Error Code Supported by Android Supported by iOS Supported by Simulator Development Suggestion
Invalid request parameter type. 1 Yes Yes Yes Check whether the index type in the interface invoking parameter is valid based on errorMsg.
Invalid value of the request parameter. 2 Yes Yes Yes Check whether the value of the parameter in the interface invoking parameter is valid based on errorMsg and whether the value of index is within the reasonable range of the tabbar index configured in the current Mini Program. The proper value ranges from 0 to the configured number of tabbars minus 1.
The request parameter is not mandatory. 3 Yes Yes Yes Check whether the interface invoking parameter contains the index parameter based on errorMsg.
